description: A utility SHALL be implemented in C using the C11 standard for Linux and use only libc, libssl/libcrypto, and libcurl, with no other external dependencies. The code SHALL compile without warnings using `gcc -O2 -o ferramenta de processamento main.c -lssl -lcrypto -lcurl`. The utility SHALL include a Makefile with an `all` target that compiles and a `clean` target that removes the binary and `.o` files.
name: plataforma_e_compilacao
